Package org.apache.juneau.commons.secret

package org.apache.juneau.commons.secret
A small, JDK-only SPI for storing and retrieving secrets by key — the secure, mutable sibling of PropertySource.

The interface + built-in implementations in this package have zero third-party runtime dependencies. Sensitivity is intrinsic: secret values are held as char[] (never String) and are never toString()'d, logged, or dumped. Backends that reach an OS keychain, a remote vault, or a cloud secret manager live in separate opt-in modules, never here.

Key types:
  • SecretStore — the SPI (store / find / exists / delete).
  • InMemorySecretStore — the zero-config, process-local default.
  • EnvVarSecretStore — a read-only, environment-variable-backed source.
  • SecretStoreProvider — ServiceLoader discovery.
  • SecretStores — BeanStore resolution (default InMemorySecretStore).
  • SecretStorePropertySource — an opt-in bridge exposing a store as a redacting PropertySource.
Since:
10.0.0
